problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Minimize F(m,C)=E[V(m+Cξ)]−Σᵢlog Cᵢᵢ over lower-triangular C with positive diagonal, with ξ∼N(0,I_d).

problem_class.label: strongly_convex
problem_class.details: V has L-Lipschitz gradient and μ-strongly monotone gradient, with 0<μ≤L; the Gaussian location–Cholesky objective is μ-strongly convex in the Euclidean/Frobenius product geometry.

problem_class.label: composite
problem_class.details: The objective combines the smooth expected potential with the convex negative-log-diagonal entropy term on the Cholesky domain.

oracle.label: exact_gradient
oracle.details: A query x∈ℝ^d returns ∇V(x) exactly. Gaussian expectations and gradients of the variational objective are not supplied by the oracle.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: Full-covariance Gaussian family in ℝ^d, represented by a mean and a lower-triangular scale matrix with strictly positive diagonal.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Public parameters are d,L,μ,R,ε,m₀,C₀, with R≥0 and ε>0. The hidden potential admits a Cholesky minimizer satisfying ‖m₀−m*‖²+‖C₀−C*‖_F²≤R²; no initial objective-gap bound is required.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: Return measurable Gaussian parameters with positive-diagonal lower-triangular scale for every outcome; the objective gap must be integrable and at most ε in expectation.

accuracy.label: expected
accuracy.details: E[F(m_out,C_out)−F(m*,C*)]≤ε under the execution probability law; no pointwise objective-gap guarantee is required.

setup_category.label: classical
setup_category.reason: Full-covariance Gaussian variational inference for a smooth strongly log-concave target, using pointwise potential gradients and expected variational objective accuracy, is an established formulation.
